label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Decode marketing terms: Clarity for your business.
body: Get 102 internet marketing terms, from A to Z, explained in plain English, so you can speak the language of online business with confidence.
caption: Ever feel like you need a translator for all the marketing jargon out there? From SEO to conversion rates, it can feel overwhelming trying to keep up. Our FREE guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary,' breaks down 102 essential marketing terms in simple, plain English. 💡 No more guessing! Just clear, straightforward explanations from A to Z, designed for creators, freelancers, and small business
